Nora - CS: Quick capture from ChannelCare renewal call. They surfaced 3 product asks that we should capture for triage.
Ishan - PM: Nice. One-line per ask + these fields: customer,summary,desired_outcome,cadence,severity,renewal_risk. We'll add P0/P1/P2 + estimate after triage.
Sam - CS: From notes:
- Line-item route billing export: they need 30d per-route+model exports to reconcile chargebacks (finance flagged)
- Guided infra quickstart: engineers stalled on env/key naming -> want <10min runbook/setup script
- Embedding lifecycle controls: dedup & retention policy in console after bulk imports (search noise)
Rae - Eng: For billing export, daily aggregates should be fine. Effort M unless they need per-call.
Nora - CS: I asked finance if sampling (1-in-10) is acceptable and requested a 50-row sample + import logs for embeds.
Ishan - PM: Use this CSV header when posting to the board:

```
customer,summary,desired_outcome,cadence,severity,renewal_risk,priority,estimate,notes
ChannelCare,Route billing export,30d daily per-route export,daily,high,yes,P0,M,Finance needs for renewal convo
ChannelCare,Infra quickstart,<10min infra setup,one-off,medium,no,P1,S,Include key rotation steps
ChannelCare,Embedding lifecycle UI,enable dedup+retention,intermittent,medium,no,P2,M,Need sample import + logs
```

InfraBot: Imported Zendesk ticket #5542: "duplicates after import, some vectors identical"
Ishan - PM: Scheduling 30-min triage tomorrow 9:30am PT with Rae + Nora. After triage we'll assign owners and lock priority. Thanks :thumbsup:
